::: {.div style="font-size:2em;"}
Welcome to Year 1 research methods and statistics!
:::

This year you will begin your journey through the world of research methods, and data coding and statistics with R with us. You will complete two research methods and statistics modules: 

- PSYC4141: Introduction to Psychological Research, with Carly Anderson, Rob Davies, Sam Finnerty, and Margriet Groen (coordinator), 

- PSYC4242: Foundations of Psychological Research, with Katie Alcock, Sam Finnerty and John Towse (coordinator)

Click on the button below to access your module: Term 1: PSYC4141, Term 2: PSYC4242.
